rationale: Adds a development-only token-reference census (tools/import-validation/token_ref_census.mjs) that loads a panel in Chromium and classifies, per colour, spacing and radius use, the authored declaration CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode reports. It writes a report and changes no capture, IR, importer, emitter or renderer behavior; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
